bullets.text: A 17-year-old student died after a car driven by his minor friend crashed on the Tambaram-Maduravoyal bypass road.

Continuous heavy rainfall has caused widespread waterlogging across Chennai city and surrounding areas like Velachery.

Residents have flagged severe safety risks as silt cleared from canals and stormwater drains is piled up along Velachery roads.

Residents of Karukku Old Road in Ambattur faced severe waterlogging for the second consecutive year.
Officials inspected the Rs 4,800 crore desalination plant project in Minjur designed to meet North Chennai water demands.
Tamil Nadu is developing the AI-enabled e-Sevai 2.0 platform to integrate up to 1,000 government services under one roof.
The MeitY secretary noted that 303 government and critical-sector websites are vulnerable to PHP programming language flaws.
IIT Madras plans to study the feasibility of small data centres for AI inference across agriculture, space, manufacturing, and healthcare.
TVK party members questioned former minister Sekarbabu regarding flood management in Chennai during previous years.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss urged the Tamil Nadu government to drop its attempt to privatize registration and land survey tasks.
